principles: Make the existing invariant TRUE again; never relax or special-case the contract to hide drift.
Single source of truth: register commands where the registry actually derives from (PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS), not where the spread combiner lives.
Classify each command from its handler behavior (read-only vs mutating, gate-consumed or not), never guess.
Minimal diff in the safe direction: keep DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS a subset of command-policy allowedPhases; change config only if the contract still drifts after registration.
Verification of record is an explicit green npm run test:process-fact-contract run, since the gate does not run this guard.
drivers: Live broken framework invariant (RED on main) blocking dependent story B-99b6.
Must not collide with parallel stories B-99b6 (battery wiring) and B-6666 (gitRoot).
Accuracy of level/category/owner matters: a wrong classification registers a misleading process fact.

options.name: register-at-source
pros: Satisfies both contract checks (MAIN_TOOLS membership + phase-allowlist drift) at the true source
Smallest correct diff; entries flow automatically into the derived registry and pull allowedPhases from existing policy
cons: Requires reading 3 handlers to classify accurately
Must verify empirically whether config.ts needs any edit

options.name: relax-contract
cons: Hides the invariant instead of satisfying it
Defeats the purpose of the double-contract; rejected by background

options.name: register-and-wire-battery
pros: Would make the gate enforce the contract
cons: Collides with B-99b6 which owns battery coupling

rationale: register-at-source satisfies the invariant at the real source of truth (process-fact-levels.ts, from which the registry derives), reads each handler to classify the 7 commands accurately (3 read-only L0, 4 mutating L2, none gate-consumed), and keeps config in the safe subset direction — touching config.ts only if the contract still drifts after registration. relax-contract hides the problem; register-and-wire-battery collides with B-99b6. This is the minimal correct fix with no behavior change.

preMortem.scenario: Implementer edits process-fact-registry.ts line 871 (spread combiner) instead of process-fact-levels.ts
preMortem.consequence: Edit has no effect; contract stays RED; or duplicate/broken array
preMortem.mitigation: plan.md and the implementer prompt explicitly state the edit target is process-fact-levels.ts; verify with a green contract run after build

preMortem.scenario: A command is misclassified (signature_registry_set given a gateConsumer it does not have, or a mutating command marked L0)
preMortem.trigger: Guessing level/category instead of reading the handler
preMortem.consequence: Registry registers a false process fact; contract may pass but the audit record is wrong
preMortem.mitigation: Classification table derived from reading each handler (signature-registry.ts/playbook.ts/recall.ts) and confirmed in plan.md: read-only=>L0, mutating-no-gate=>L2, none gate-consumed; reviewer cross-checks

preMortem.scenario: Implementer also edits config.ts unnecessarily and breaks the subset invariant or another phase allowlist
preMortem.trigger: Assuming config must change without first testing
preMortem.consequence: New drift introduced; possibly widens a phase allowlist beyond policy
preMortem.mitigation: plan.md mandates: register entries first, build, run contract; only edit config.ts if drift persists, and only in the safe subset direction

preMortem.scenario: Edit accidentally touches a handler / cli-engine.ts / gitRoot code
preMortem.consequence: Behavior change or collision with B-6666
preMortem.mitigation: execution_boundary allowedPaths restricts to process-fact-levels.ts/process-fact-registry.ts/config.ts/package.json; git diff reviewed; reviewer checks scope

preMortem.scenario: tsc breaks because a new entry violates the ProcessFactLevelEntry type
preMortem.trigger: Typo in level/category field or wrong shape
preMortem.mitigation: npm --prefix packages/main run build must pass (exit 0) before declaring done; mirror existing entry shape exactly
